name: appworld-interactive-code
description: Operate official AppWorld tasks through on-demand API documentation and a stateful Python shell.
instructions: Use get_api_docs to inspect an app's API list and then the exact contract of every unfamiliar API before calling it.
In execute_python, call APIs as apis.<app_name>.<api_name>(...) and print any value that must be visible in the next turn.
The Python shell is stateful within one episode, so preserve useful access tokens and intermediate values, but do not assume shell variables survive environment checkpoint restoration.
Read all required pages or batches before deciding that an item is absent; avoid modifying records until the target identity and requested change are verified.
Use finish only after the requested database changes are complete. Supply its answer field only when the task asks a question.
